'''bounty hunter6 Retrieval LS Combat''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bounty hunter6]]
* '''Published:''' 8 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif|label=We'll Handle This}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' We'll Handle This
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 WHT hunter6 LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Holotable, Princess Leia (V), Luke Skywalker (V), Escape Pod (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Crazy destiny and retrieval...I've seen this deck win 90 percent of the time...

== Notes ==

* The dash-prefixed lines after the starting cards are outside the 60 (the section headers sum to 60 without them); they are the Defensive Shields.
* Posted 'Holotable' matches no Light card in the pool (only the Dark Imperial Holotable); marked UNKNOWN. Probably Dejarik Hologameboard (Light holosite, fetched by Escape Pod (V)), not confirmed.
* Original-era (V) slips: Princess Leia (VS6), Luke Skywalker x2 (VS1), Escape Pod x2 (VS2), Traffic Control (VS3, shield), Weapons Display (VS6, shield). Sai'torr Kal Fas unmarked, so printed.
* Duplicates of unique characters as posted: Lando, Luke (V), Qui-Gon, Obi-Wan, Yoda x2 each.
* Posted 'Theepio, with His Parts Showing' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Naboo Docking Bay' Naboo: Theed Palace Docking Bay; 'Malastair' Malastare; 'Anakin's Racer' Anakin's Podracer.

== Strategy ==

This deck has insanely high destiny with insanely high retrieve…

Average Destiny- 3.45

Without Locations/I Did It- 3.91

Podrace, Retrieve, Win

Deploy Jedi, use combat cards… If they have Ability ^3 (V) on table use cards that are useless to you as combat cards…If they don’t stack 7’s, get out Leia with her gun and you can use Rebel Artillery although it is not important… Once your done pod racing get out Masatair, you can drain for 2 a turn and retrieve 2 a turn (one with Luke and one with I Did It!)… Your drains should be relatively large if they don’t come after you… Flash of Insight helps you retrieve (you know when one of your 8 7’s is on top… You can pull Naked Threepio and Artoo with Seeking an Audience… You can retrieve about 4-8 force each turn and do about 2-4 damage each turn making it a very long game… Usually you won’t have a lost pile at the end of the game giving you a 25-35+ win which may help you a lot in the long run…

Flash Of Insight - helps your retrieval and helps you cycle stuff through your deck…

Escape Pod - makes it so your Jedi less vulnerable to be placed out play.

Dude seeking an audience isn't (V) I just use it to pull threepio and stuff, it is legal...

Geez Shewski, what did you do paste it to Deck Tech lol :)
